ai_summary: AARNAV FASHIONS LIMITED reported a challenging first quarter for FY2027 (ended June 30, 2026), with material declines in key financial metrics. Revenue from operations decreased by approximately 34.7% quarter-over-quarter and 10.9% year-over-year, while net profit saw a steeper fall of about 48% QoQ and 11% YoY. This significant reduction in both sales and profitability is a notable concern, despite the statutory auditors issuing a clean limited review report.
